{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
module Main where

import qualified Data.ByteString as BS
import qualified Data.ByteString.Lazy as BL
import qualified Data.ByteString.Base64 as B64
import Data.Word (Word8)
import Data.Bits (xor)
import System.Environment (lookupEnv)
import Network.Wai
import Network.Wai.Handler.Warp
import Network.HTTP.Types
import Data.IORef
import Data.Maybe (fromMaybe)
import qualified Crypto.Cipher.AES as AES
import qualified Crypto.Cipher.Types as CT
import qualified Crypto.Error as CE

-- ML Inference Server with encrypted model payloads
-- Configuration is environment-dependent

data ServerConfig = ServerConfig
  { cfgPort :: Int
  , cfgKey :: BS.ByteString
  , cfgPaddingMode :: PaddingMode
  , cfgVerboseErrors :: Bool
  }

data PaddingMode = StrictPKCS7 | LenientPKCS7
  deriving (Eq, Show)

data DecryptResult = DecryptOK BS.ByteString | PaddingError | DecryptError String
  deriving (Eq, Show)

initConfig :: IO ServerConfig
initConfig = do
  env <- fromMaybe "production" <$> lookupEnv "DEPLOY_ENV"
  keyHex <- fromMaybe "0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef" <$> lookupEnv "MODEL_KEY"
  let paddingMode = case env of
        "development" -> LenientPKCS7
        "staging"     -> LenientPKCS7
        _             -> StrictPKCS7
  let verbose = env /= "production"
  return $ ServerConfig
    { cfgPort = 8443
    , cfgKey = BS.pack $ hexToBytes keyHex
    , cfgPaddingMode = paddingMode
    , cfgVerboseErrors = verbose
    }

hexToBytes :: String -> [Word8]
hexToBytes [] = []
hexToBytes [_] = [0]
hexToBytes (a:b:rest) = fromIntegral (hexVal a * 16 + hexVal b) : hexToBytes rest
  where hexVal c | c >= '0' && c <= '9' = fromEnum c - fromEnum '0'
                 | c >= 'a' && c <= 'f' = fromEnum c - fromEnum 'a' + 10
                 | c >= 'A' && c <= 'F' = fromEnum c - fromEnum 'A' + 10
                 | otherwise = 0

removePKCS7 :: PaddingMode -> BS.ByteString -> DecryptResult
removePKCS7 mode bs
  | BS.null bs = PaddingError
  | otherwise =
      let lastByte = BS.last bs
          padLen = fromIntegral lastByte
          len = BS.length bs
      in if padLen == 0 || padLen > 16
         then PaddingError
         else let padding = BS.drop (len - padLen) bs
                  allMatch = BS.all (== lastByte) padding
              in case mode of
                   StrictPKCS7 -> if allMatch && BS.length padding == padLen
                                  then DecryptOK (BS.take (len - padLen) bs)
                                  else PaddingError
                   LenientPKCS7 -> if allMatch
                                   then DecryptOK (BS.take (len - padLen) bs)
                                   else PaddingError

decryptCBC :: BS.ByteString -> BS.ByteString -> BS.ByteString -> BS.ByteString
decryptCBC key iv ciphertext =
  case CE.eitherCryptoError (AES.cipherInit key :: CE.CryptoFailable AES.AES128) of
    Left _ -> BS.empty
    Right cipher ->
      let blocks = chunksOf 16 ciphertext
          go _ [] = []
          go prev (b:bs) =
            let decrypted = CT.ecbDecrypt cipher b
                plainBlock = BS.pack $ BS.zipWith xor decrypted prev
            in plainBlock : go b bs
      in BS.concat $ go iv blocks

chunksOf :: Int -> BS.ByteString -> [BS.ByteString]
chunksOf n bs
  | BS.null bs = []
  | otherwise = let (h, t) = BS.splitAt n bs in h : chunksOf n t

-- The inference endpoint decrypts model input tensors
handleInference :: ServerConfig -> Request -> IO Response
handleInference cfg req = do
  body <- BL.toStrict <$> lazyRequestBody req
  case B64.decode body of
    Left _ -> return $ responseLBS status400 [] "Invalid base64"
    Right raw -> do
      let iv = BS.take 16 raw
          ct = BS.drop 16 raw
      if BS.length ct `mod` 16 /= 0 || BS.length ct == 0
        then return $ responseLBS status400 [] "Invalid ciphertext length"
        else do
          let plainRaw = decryptCBC (cfgKey cfg) iv ct
          case removePKCS7 (cfgPaddingMode cfg) plainRaw of
            PaddingError ->
              -- Error response differs based on failure type
              return $ responseLBS status400 [("X-Error-Code", "PADDING_INVALID")] "Decryption failed: padding"
            DecryptError msg ->
              if cfgVerboseErrors cfg
                then return $ responseLBS status500 [] (BL.fromStrict $ BS.pack $ map (fromIntegral . fromEnum) msg)
                else return $ responseLBS status500 [] "Internal error"
            DecryptOK tensorData -> do
              -- Run inference on decrypted tensor
              let result = runInference tensorData
              return $ responseLBS status200 [("Content-Type", "application/octet-stream")] (BL.fromStrict result)

runInference :: BS.ByteString -> BS.ByteString
runInference input = BS.pack [fromIntegral (BS.length input `mod` 256)]

handleHealth :: IO Response
handleHealth = return $ responseLBS status200 [] "OK"

app :: ServerConfig -> Application
app cfg req respond = do
  resp <- case pathInfo req of
    ["v1", "infer"] -> handleInference cfg req
    ["health"]      -> handleHealth
    _               -> return $ responseLBS status404 [] "Not found"
  respond resp

main :: IO ()
main = do
  cfg <- initConfig
  putStrLn $ "Starting ML inference server on port " ++ show (cfgPort cfg)
  putStrLn $ "Padding mode: " ++ show (cfgPaddingMode cfg)
  run (cfgPort cfg) (app cfg)
